title: Add rootfs TUI console defaults
purpose: Package TUI as the default AgentOS operator console while preserving headless and scripted automation paths.
scope: Add rootfs config defaults for TUI durable runtime paths and operator mode.
Update operator command registry with TUI commands.
Declare demo, durable, scripted and headless modes explicitly.
Validate config during alpha rootfs validation.
Document default console behavior in packaging evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Packaged rootfs declares TUI as primary operator console.
Headless mode remains available for CI and automation.
Validator fails if TUI config is missing required durable paths.
Operator registry does not include arbitrary shell command entries.
failure_modes: Rootfs defaults point TUI at transient state.
Operator registry adds shell escape commands.
